name: typing-indicator
title: Typing indicator
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Polite live region that names who is typing, including “Ana and 2 others are typing…”.

meta.descriptionEs: Región en vivo que dice quién escribe.

examples.title: Campo
examples.description: Priya escribe y el campo propio se apaga tras un segundo.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Cero, uno, dos y varios nombres.

api.name: field
api.description: Presence key that is true while typing. Default isTyping.

api.name: label
api.description: Override the sentence. Default is English.

docs: Requires PresenceProvider. The region uses aria-live="polite". Pair it with useTypingPresence on the local field.
